answer: Each identity keeps a unique 32 GB model shard resident in GPU VRAM, its blocks laid in a spiral derived from its key. Every 4 minutes verifiers send a simultaneous falcon-fast challenge: return a hash of a lotus-indexed block within 150 ms. Disk or a shared GPU misses the deadline, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 GPUs holding 32 TB of VRAM, about $1.6 million in hardware plus power. Three misses revoke the slot. Trade-off: agents without GPUs are excluded.
